- `models.py`: Provides base classes for Typer's internal data structures, such as `Context` and `FileText`. This is foundational for defining and handling CLI contexts and file operations. (Line 10)
- `params.py`: Defines the `Option` class and related utilities for declaring and handling command-line options and parameters. This is essential for parsing and validating user inputs. (Line 10)
- `completion.py`: Implements shell completion features, including installation and display of completion scripts for different shells. It also overrides Click’s shell completion logic to maintain compatibility with older versions. (Line 10)
- `exceptions.py`: Defines custom exceptions used within Typer, such as `TyperException`, `Abort`, and `Exit`. These exceptions help in signaling specific error conditions and control flow during CLI execution. (Line 10)
